scope: Pre-commit documentation/evidence publication review; final commit/classification/Git-data tree equality/expected-head update/readback remain integrator obligations

live_remote_readback.timing: Observed through connected GitHub API during this review; recheck immediately before publication

content_scan.scope: Targeted private-key/token/signed-URL patterns, UTF-8 and executable magic; not exhaustive secret certification

historical_classifier_hash_interpretatio.meaning: SHA-256 of retained classification output text, not of the classifier program

findings.observation: Historical source-map classifier_sha256 fields identify classification output text, not classifier program bodies. All three output hashes independently match. Prepared final classifier and policy bodies separately match exact c9d Git blobs.

remaining_integrator_checks: Finish all 60 actual workers, finalize the ledger from completion notifications, and rehash each final receipt without circular dependencies.

Confirm the final candidate adds only the reviewed documentation/evidence plus expected final review/ledger updates; no executable implementation, protected asset, unrelated user file or unexpected payload may enter the index.
Commit locally on master after final scoped governance and whitespace checks. Construct the publication manifest from that committed Git tree, preserving exact blob bodies, modes and paths.
Run the c9d base revision classifier and policy extracted outside the checkout against the actual final local commit. Record its actual output; this review does not predict a classification.
Read live remote master again. If it differs from the expected parent, stop the update, preserve and reconcile concurrent history, then rebuild/review the publication tree; never force push.

Create any Git-data blobs and tree only in baabi-boo/AI-GPU. Require every uploaded binary blob SHA and the returned complete tree SHA to equal the local committed objects before creating the remote commit.
Create the remote commit with the exact expected parent and reviewed tree, then use force=false and expected_sha for the master ref update.
Fetch the resulting remote commit; verify branch/ref, parent, exact tree equality and clean worktree before soft-aligning the local branch to API metadata. Report the actual final remote commit.

Report validation at the exact qualified code revision separately from the later evidence commit; preserve pending/failed/limited overall CI and vendor/DSP obligations without claiming a fully green pipeline.
limitations: Inspected snapshot counts exclude this review and later finalization writes; they are not an assertion of the final publication path count or tree hash.
Targeted content patterns and executable-magic checks are bounded inspections, not an exhaustive secret or malware certification.
Compressed evidence contains source, logs, identities and configuration bodies; native binaries, complete external tool/dependency bodies and physical-device attestation are not provided.
User authorization for direct master delivery is recorded in the conversation; this advisory review does not invent a human sign-off, policy waiver or completed publication.
